title: Introducing the Instant Kill Arrow Turret
description:
Turns out you can get the player's view angle from wind charges. This will have substantial ramifications for the population of Minecraft servers. In this video we discover new revolutionary cannon tech and understand the dynamics of explosion interactions and how we can use wind charges combined with TnT mechanics to make the ultimate instant kill railcannon.

Please note that this build has been broken as of 1.21.5:
https://www.mediafire.com/file/1zh80q14wed2kre/The_Orbital_Railcannon.litematic/file

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FnUE-ZaALLw
